S.FORM: alang Tjaialev ga niya mki sku Heto Keng atu Taybu go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 27 buwan, 97 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 97% kyan ku 94 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 3% kyan ku 3 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Paywan 93%, Amis 2%, binah lihuyan s'uli 1%. rhzyal kki'an tay 'zil na Tjaialev hya' ga Ludja. rekisi kayal kyokay ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ tjaiale* ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku ħeto keŋ atu tajβu ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa ** βuwan ** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku ** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa * kjan ku * ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa pajwan ** ami[s|ɕ] * βinaħ liħujan [s|ɕ]ʔuli * rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔzil na tjaiale* ħjaʔ ɣa lu*ja reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
